scenes.heading: Pricing add-on services: paid ads, influencer outreach, and strategy

sents.d: Pricing add-on services: paid ads, influencer outreach, and strategy
Core content management and add-on services are different skill sets and should be priced separately.

Running paid social ads, coordinating influencer partnerships, or doing deeper strategy work are meaningfully different skills from day-to-day content posting and community management — pricing them as separate line items, rather than folding them into a flat retainer, reflects the extra time and expertise involved.

Being honest about which of these you're actually skilled at (versus willing to figure out on a client's budget) protects both your reputation and the client's results — subcontracting or partnering with a specialist is often better than learning paid ads for the first time on a paying client's account.
Offering these as clearly defined optional add-ons at the proposal stage, rather than bundling everything into one price, also makes it easier for clients to start smaller and expand later.

take: Sell ads, influencer work and strategy as separate add-ons.
